parity_reason: Each criterion differs by at most 1 and neither image has a critical defect, but the totals are 31 for A and 29 for B, which is a gap of 2. That breaks condition 2.

reference.summary: A beaver chef in a white hat and sun-decorated apron fries two sunny-side-up eggs in a pan on a stove with a spatula, in a bright kitchen with a smiling sun in the window; it is clean and well drawn, with a few small oddities.

defects.what: A small pink heart floats in mid-air above the pan for no clear reason
defects.where: above the frying pan, right of the spatula
defects.expected: Only the scene's own elements appear above the pan, such as steam or sizzle marks if needed

defects.what: The beaver's spatula arm is a long, thin tube that comes out from behind the apron and looks stretched
defects.where: the beaver's right arm reaching toward the pan
defects.expected: The arm has the same chunky thickness as the rest of the beaver's body and reaches the pan in a natural way

defects.what: The spatula blade hovers above the eggs and does not touch the pan or the food
defects.expected: The spatula blade rests in the pan or under an egg, so the beaver is clearly cooking

defects.what: A plate with an egg sits on the very corner edge of the stove and looks about to fall off
defects.where: lower right corner of the stove
defects.expected: The plate sits steadily on a counter or flat surface next to the stove

defects.what: A small stray cross mark appears on the chef hat's band
defects.expected: The hat band is plain and clean

attempt.summary: A large beaver chef with a white hat cooks two sunny-side-up eggs in a pan on a stove counter in a warm kitchen; the main idea reads clearly, but the tail floats away from the body and the spatula is just a plain bar.

defects.what: The beaver's flat tail floats in the air beside the body and is not joined to it
defects.where: left side, the dark oval tail
defects.expected: The tail clearly attaches to the beaver's lower back or rump and comes out from behind the body

defects.what: The spatula is just a plain grey rod with a rounded end and has no flat turner blade, so it is hard to recognise
defects.where: the utensil in the pan on the right
defects.expected: The utensil reads clearly as a spatula, with a handle and a flat, wide blade resting under or beside an egg

defects.what: The beaver's paw only touches the middle of the spatula rod loosely, so it is unclear whether the beaver is gripping it
defects.where: the beaver's right paw at the spatula
defects.expected: The paw clearly wraps around the spatula's handle

defects.what: The chef hat seems to sit on top of the head instead of fitting around it
defects.expected: The hat band fits snugly around the top of the head

defects.what: The beaver's body is cut off by the counter, and the left arm seems to rest on the counter without doing anything
defects.where: the beaver's lower body and left arm
defects.expected: The beaver's pose clearly shows both paws taking part in the cooking or resting naturally
